notes.title: Knightenator Plays Silent Slayer: Vault of the Vampire - Steam Release Stream
notes.notes:
Hail to you, Slayer!

Silent Slayer: Vault of the Vampire is now available on Steam! Watch Knigtenator as she takes on the role of a vampire slayer on a mythic quest to eliminate powerful sleeping monsters in this prerecorded Steam broadcast. Take advantage of a 20% Steam launch discount until 10/21, and settle in for some late night, spooky season vibes. 

Tune in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561198073151987]here[/url]!
